\begin{example} \end{example}[CW structure on complex projective space $\CP ^n$] ↗ def:cell-complex 1. ch0:0.6\group CW Complexes

$\CP ^n$ is the space of complex lines in $\C ^{n+1}$. Viewing it as the quotient of the unit sphere in $\C ^{n+1}$ by multiplication by unit complex scalars, or as a disk $D^{2n}$ with its boundary identified under this action, shows that $\CP ^n$ is obtained from $\CP ^{n-1}$ by attaching a $2n$-cell. Hence $\CP ^n=e^0\cup e^2\cup \cdots \cup e^{2n}$, and $\CP ^\infty $ has one cell in each even dimension. \end{example}
